Commentary.Commentary: Now the target is a big one but we saw South Africa chase something similar in the last game. Can they do it again or will the England bowlers have their say this time? Join us for the chase in a bit.

For South Africa, Ngidi began brilliantly with three in no time but that was it! The others failed to take wickets to capitalize on the start Lungi Ngidi gave them and after that they just could not stem the run-flow. Most of the bowlers were taken to the cleaners and South Africa will not be happy with how things stand at the moment.

The two began slowly, really slowly actually, England were going for under 4 per over for the first 15 overs or so but such was the nature of the wicket, it was doing a bit but the two weathered the storm and once they got their eye in, they really took the bowlers to the cleaners. They added over 200 and took the game away from England. At one time, 350 looked possible but England lost a few wickets towards the end which did not let them get to that mark.

What a recovery that is! Let me remind you, England were 3 down for below 20 and they have ended with a score more than their last game. To add to that, they have managed to score over 200 runs in the last 20 overs. Absolutly unreal and they have just the two men to thank for this, Jos Buttler and Dawid Malan! Outstanding tons from them has taken England to a score which we feel is well above par.

On off, Rashid whips it to deep mid-wicket and calls for two. He gives up while he runs for the second but Heinrich Klaasen misses the stumps from yards out as he tries to flick. England end with 346.
Bye! A bouncer on middle. Chris Woakes misses his pull and the batters snitch a quick bye.
Very full and on middle, this is driven past cover for two.
On a length and outside off, heaved across in the gap to deep mid-wicket for two more.
Full and on middle, whipped to deep mid-wicket for one more.
SIX! A full toss, angling on the pads. Rashid just helps it along the way behind square leg for a biggie. Will we see 350 crossed?
Two runs to end the over! Full toss on middle, flicked to square leg for a brace.
Ngidi serves it wide of off, away from Woakes. The batter swings and misses.
Around off, it is driven through covers for one.
A slower ball, outside off, this is hit over point for one.
Very full and outside off. Rashid drops it to cover for a single.
Very full and on off, pushed to long off for one.
OUT! BOWLED! Jansen gets second wicket. A slower ball, length and around off, angles in. Curran is late as he looks to punch but misses and the ball hits the off pole.
Two more as this is hit to deep mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off. Curran slaps it down to long on for a brace.
SIX! Curran goes big! Full and outside off, this is tonked over long off for a six.
On off, pushed to covers for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! This will make a difference of 10-15 runs. End of an excellent innings from the skipper. Fuller and outside off, angling across. Buttler swings his bat across but it goes off the inner half as his bat turns and Aiden Markram at long on takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Aiden Markram b Marco Jansen

Commentary.Commentary: Full toss on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
A single as it is hit to square leg.

OUT! TIMBER! This time it is a legal delivery and the wicket will stand. Lungi Ngidi tried twice previously but failed but not this time. Ngidi serves another yorker, on leg. Ali looks to flick but misses and gets beaten around the leg and the stumps are disturbed.
A yorker, tailing on the stumps. Ali shuffles way too much to heave but misses and the stumps are disturbed.

No ball! Lungi Ngidi was appealing for a LBW but the umpire signals a no ball as he has overstepped again. A yorker, angling on the pads. Ali misses his flick. This is not looking good for South Africa.
SIX! Makes the most of it. Lungi Ngidi have been poor in his second spell! Length ball on off. Ali powers it over cow corner for a six.
SIX! SMOKED! 300 up! Short of a length and outside off. Ali this time shuffles across and pulls it over square leg for a six. That is a NO BALL as well. Ngidi has overstepped.
Serves a bouncer, outside off. Ali leaves it.
A single as this is hit to long off.
Just three of the over! Full and outside off. Ali taps and asks for a single but is sent back by Buttler wisely. Jansen picks and has a shy but misses. Tell you what, Ali was a goner if that hit.
Well bowled! Full and on off, eased out to long on for one.
A slower short ball on off, pulled away to deep square leg for one.
This is on middle. Buttler mistimes his pull. It goes high and lands safely in the mid-wicket region.
Very full and outside off. Buttler tries to reverse hit but fails to connect.
SIX! A boundary in this over as well. A full toss on the pads, Ali heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
This is very full and on off. Buttler cue ends his lofted shot to long off for a single.
On off, kept out.
A single as this is hit to long on for one.
Leg bye! A yorker on leg. Buttler misses his heave and gets hit on the pads. A leg bye as it rolls to point.
Very full and on off, worked to cover for a single.
Around off, Ali steps across and tucks it to square leg for one.
SIX! CONNECTED! Short again, outside off. Ali stands back and hammers it over long on for a six.
Quicker and outside off. Ali looks to reverse hit but misses. Almost hit it with one hand.
On off, pushed to long off for one.
SIX! BANG! Buttler read it well. Buttler follows Shamsi on the leg side and hits this short ball over square leg for a six. Very clever.
Outside off again, cut to deep point for one.
Wide! Way outside off. Ali steps across to cut but misses.
On middle, this is hit to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Poor from Parnell! On the pads. Ali whips it behind square leg for a boundary.
Leg bye! On the hips, Buttler misses his pull and it goes off the pads to point for one.
SIX! Buttler continues to shine! Too full and on leg. Buttler stands tall and heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Goes for the yorker, outside off. Buttler swings and misses.
Short and on middle, this is pulled behind square leg for two.
Shorter and on off, punched past cover for one more.
A single as this is hit to deep cover.
Leg bye! On the pads, Buttler misses his flick and it goes off the pads to square leg for one.
JUST OVER! Short and outside off, spins away. Ali chips it over covers. The fielder there leaps and gets a hand on it but it was always going over. Too difficult.
Flighted, outside off, spins away. Ali swings wildly and misses.
On the leg side, Buttler works it to square leg for one.
Length ball, angling outside off. Ali looks to push but misses.
FOUR! Instant impact from Ali! Short and outside  off, it is hit away to third man for four.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! Finally, finally the stand is broken. Relieve for South Africa as these two were hammering them away. End of a beautiful innings from Malan. He has done his job. Full and on off. Malan tries to slog-sweep but gets a top edge, high up and to short fine leg where the keeper, Heinrich Klaasen runs across and takes it. Much needed for South Africa.
Commentary.Howout: c Heinrich Klaasen b Sisanda Magala

Commentary.Commentary: Short and around off. Malan watches it go past him.
Full and on off, pushed to covers for a single.
SIX! There is no stopping these two right now. Full and around off. Buttler smacks it over long on for a six.
Another single as this is pushed towards cover.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
SIX! Well over the fence. This was asking to be hit. Full and on middle, this is heaved over the long on fence for another biggie.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Just the single from the Free Hit! On middle, this is pulled down to long on for one.
NO BALL! Shorter and on middle, Malan looks to pull but it goes off the underedge on the leg side.
SIX! BANG! That is out of here! Length and on off, shorter, this is pulled well over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.

He gets it too! Outstanding knock and the skipper yet again leading from the front. Excellent knock, he has batted with a lot of responsibility. Gets there by working this full ball through mid-wicket for two.
Now takes one as he guides it down to third man. Buttler now has one ball to get to his ton.

FOUR! 100 for Malan! Unreal batting from him in the last hour or so. Also, he got to his ton before Buttler who was well ahead of him at one time. Really good placement! Shorter and outside off, he guides it past short third man for a boundary.
Buttler onto 99 now! Full and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
A single as this is hit down to long on. Malan is onto 99!
On off, this is pushed to cover.
A slower short ball, this is pulled down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, Jos Buttler mistimes the pull on the leg side for one.
Around off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Shorter and around off, this is upper cut towards third man for one.
Two more! Outside off, this is guided through point for two. Both on 96 now.
A slower one on off, this is guided down to third man for one.
FOUR! Hammered! A gift to end, a full toss outside off, this is thumped through covers for a boundary. The last ball spoils the over.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Wided.
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled behind square on the leg side for one.
A slower one outside off, this is guided through point for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is played down to long on for one more.
A good yorker, this is jammed down to long on for one.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one more.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for two.
Another beauty! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Buttler looks to drive but is beaten again.
BEATEN! Length and on off, this lands and cuts away. Buttler is beaten as he tries to push at it.
A slower one outside off, this is mistimed towards cover for one.
SIX! Raining sixes here! Aiden Markram probably felt Buttler might come down the track and drags it short, this is pulled over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Pushes this one through on the leg pole, it is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Buttler now happy to play second fiddle! On the pads, this is nudged towards mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A dot to end but another big over for England. The momentum and the balance of the game has shifted. Outside off, not played at.
Shorter and around off, this is guided through point for one.
SIX! Over mid-wicket again! Malan is putting on a show here. He has now overtaken Buttler. 17 from the over with two balls to go. On middle, this is heaved over the mid-wicket fence for a big one.
FOUR! Malan is turning it on here. Bowls it short to Malan, he has no problems in swiveling and pulling it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
SIX! BANG! Malan now has almost caught up with Buttler! Reads the length early here, on middle, shorter, this is pulled over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On the pads, this is worked around the corner for one.
FOUR! Hammered away! This is short and asking to be hit. Dawid Malan slams it through covers and it races away. A boundary at least in the last three overs.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard but towards deep square leg for one.
On middle, this is worked to square leg.
Shorter and on middle, Jos Buttler looks to pull but this one turns and there is some extra bounce, he is hit on the body.
The reverse sweep comes out, it is just gently played towards short third man for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed back towards the bowler, to his right, Aiden Markram dives and stops it.

SIX! Buttler this time sends it into the stands! This is floated up on middle, yet again a little too full, Buttler gets under it and sends it sailing over the mid-wicket fence. Second in the over and back-to-back big overs for the visitors.
On the pad, this is nudged on the leg side for one.
SIX! BANG! The 150 is up! Malan is in his elements now. This is tossed up on middle, Malan goes down on one knee and lofts it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Another single as this is worked through square leg.
Shorter and on off, Malan pushes it through covers for one.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
A dot to end but the damage was done earlier on! On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
FOUR! Excellent placement! That was not a very bad delivery! It is slightly short and outside off, Malan waits and then plays it past point. This one races away to the fence.
Length and on off, Malan looks to drive, it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Another quick single! On middle, this is pushed to mid on for one.
Now follows it up with one as he nudges it on the leg side.

SIX! That came out of nowhere! Malan gets his fifty up in style! Has he decided to step on the gas though? This is on off, Malan walks across and heaves it over the square leg fence. That was dragged from outside off. A hardworking knock from Malan. He needs to go on though.
On off, Malan is early as he pushes on the up and Shamsi dives to his right but fails to hold on. Tell you what that was a good chance. Could have done better.
Fuller and outside off, Malan drives but finds point.
Tossed up on middle. Blocked out.
Good stop! Too full and on middle. Malan reverse hits but the man at point makes a solid stop.
Tossed up on middle, spins in, it is hit to mid-wicket for one.
Around off, worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Edged away! Short of a length and on off. Malan looks to push but gets an inside edge past the diving keeper and it goes to fine leg for a boundary.
Length and on middle. Buttler steps forward and hits it to square leg for one.
A length ball, angled across, outside off. Buttler stays back to punch but misses.
On a length and on middle. Buttler guides it to backward point.
On the pads, worked to square leg for one.
Length and on off, Buttler carves it to point for one.
On middle, Buttler goes back and works it to square leg for one.
SIX! BANG! That is connected well! Full, floated on off. Buttler lofts it high over long on for a biggie. The stand crosses 100-run mark now.
Too full and on off, drilled to long off for one.
Floated, outside off, Malan eases it back to Shamsi.
A leggie on middle, tucked to square leg for one.
On middle, Malan pushes it back to Shamsi who fails to stop cleanly and the batters take a single.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and on off, Malan knocks it to cover.
Around off, kept out.
On a length and on off. Buttler drops it to point and takes a quick single. A direct hit at the batter's end but Malan was in.
A slower length ball, outside off. Buttler swings and misses.
Around off, pushed to covers for a single.
Flatter and on middle, kept out.
FOUR! Glanced away! On the pads, spins away. Buttler helps it to the fine leg fence.
This is around off. Buttler punches it to long off for a single.
A low full toss, outside off, drilled to long off for one.
Floated, outside off. Malan knocks it to cover.
Outside off, cut to point.
On the hips, Malan pulls it to deep square leg for one.
This is on middle. Malan tries to flick but gets a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
Length ball, outside off, Buttler punches it to sweeper cover for one.
On off, kept out.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
Wide! Short one on middle. Buttler sits. 100 up.
Outside off, steered to third man for a single.
TAP AND RUN! On off, dropped to cover for one.
Tossed up, outside off, spins away. Malan looks to defend but misses. Need more of this from Shamsi.
Flatter and on middle. Buttler hits it to square leg for a single. Fifty for Buttler! 24th in the ODIs. He needed this one. Has done well to get the ship back on track.
On middle, nudged to square leg.
Slower in the air on off, pushed to covers for a single.
Too full and on middle, played back to the bowler.
10 runs off the over then! England motoring along! On middle, this is pulled behind square leg for a single.
On off, tucked to square leg for one more.
Short in length and on middle. Buttler works it to mid-wicket for a brace.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Fuller and outside off, pushed straight to cover who misfields and allows a single.
FOUR! Boundaries are coming regularly now! Full and on middle. Buttler flicks it to deep square leg and into the fence.
Tossed up, outside off, Malan eases it to cover.
Fuller and on middle. Buttler flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
A single as this is pushed to cover.
Short again, around off. Malan pulls it just over mid-wicket for a brace. Reeza Hendricks leaps and gets a hand on it but fails to hold on. He is walking off for now.
Drops it short and on leg, it is pulled to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up on the pads. Buttler keeps it out.
Length and on off, tapped to point.
FOUR! Superb! Length and outside off, Malan drives it through covers for a boundary.
On middle, this is hit to long on for one.
On the pads, this is tucked to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, pushed to cover.
Short and on middle. Buttler looks to pull but gets a top edge to fine leg for two.

FOUR! Malan gets into the act now. Much-needed for him and this is a top over for England. They are getting a move on. The reverse sweep comes out and it is played nicely through point for a boundary.
Another single as this is nudged around the corner.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Almost! This one is tossed up around middle, drags his length back just a little than the last ball. Buttler looks to go over wide long on, it goes off the inner half towards deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Slammed down the ground! This is floated up on middle, this is tossed up on middle, a little too full again, this is hammered down the ground and to the long off fence.
Fuller and on middle, Malan pushes it down the ground to long off for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to square leg.
Length and around off, this is guided to point.
Good stop! Fuller and on off, Malan pushes it to the right of mid off. The fielder dives and stops it. Just the one.
Good length and on off, defended.
Quick run! On middle, this is worked towards mid on for one.
WIDE! Another one down the leg side. Wided.
Fuller and on off, Malan looks to drive, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Tossed up on off, this one turns back in a touch. Defended. Two good overs in a row for England.
WIDE! This is short and down the leg side, comes slow off the surface. Buttler looks to pull but misses. Wided.
A lot flatter this time and on off, Buttler blocks.
SIX! BANG! Clears the fence! That is right in the arc for Buttler. Quite full and on off, he lofts it over the long off fence for a biggie. Much-needed.
Tossed up on off, Jos Buttler pushes it back to the bowler.
A little bit of turn! This is tossed up on off, defended.
Tossed up nicely and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Two more! That is a good over then for Buttler who is now England 6th highest run getting in ODIs. Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for two.
Gets it right this time, on a length and around off, defended.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Sisanda Magala has been a little too straight and this time Buttler makes him pay! This is worked fine on the leg side for a rare boundary. Just the third of the innings.
Yet another dot! On the pads, Buttler looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Another one on the pad, Buttler flicks but to mid-wicket.
Two! Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for two.
Back of a length and on off, defended.
On middle, Malan works it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, Buttler works it to mid-wicket. The fielder there half-stops it, a run taken.
On the fuller side, this is pushed to mid off.
Extra bounce! Length and on off, Buttler defends.
Fuller and on off, Jos pushes it to mid off. A slight misfield but no run taken.
Shorter and outside off, this is played through point for one.
Angled into the pads, Buttler keeps it out.
Good length and on middle, defended.
A slower one on off, Malan pushes it through covers for one.
On the pads, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Drop and run! On a length and around off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
On the pads, Buttler pushes it to mid on and gets to the other end.
Another dot! On the stumps, kept out.
On middle, defended.
On middle, this is worked towards square leg for one more.
On the pads, again, this is worked through square leg for one.

NOT OUT! He is just about in! a direct hit and Buttler would have been gone. Brilliant from Miller. On the pads, this is clipped through square leg. They take one and Buttler goes for a second. Miller runs in, picks the ball up and as he is falling on the ground, fires it right beside the stumps. The keeper takes the bails off and appeals. Replays show Buttler is in.
Taken upstairs! An appeal for a run out has been taken upstairs. Buttler looks worried.
Shorter and outside off, Buttler chops it towards cover and takes one.
Good length outside off, Buttler leaves it alone.
Good length and on middle, defended.
Rotating strike is important when boundaries are hard to comeby! On the pads, this is nudged around the corner for one.
Another one on a length and outside off, Buttler pushes it through covers for one.
Cut away! A single only. Outside off, this is flayed through point for one.
Edgy run! Length and on off, Malan looks to defend, this goes off the outside edge down towards third man for one.
BEATEN! Malan is getting frustrated! Shorter and just outside off, Malan looks to cut but is beaten.
On middle, this one jags back in. Malan looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Good length and on off, defended.
Good length and on off, defended.
On off, Buttler pushes it through covers and takes one.
On the shorter side, Buttler rocks back and pulls it through square leg for one.
Gets his line right, lands it on off, Buttler defends.
FOUR! Buttler gets off the mark and in style! Slightly shorter and a little bit of width on offer, this is pushed through point and the ball races away. A welcome boundary.
Almost! Buttler moves right across as Jansen comes from around the wicket, this is fuller and on off, Buttler looks to play it on the leg side but it goes off a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
On the shorter side, Jos Buttler stays back and blocks.
On the pads, this is clipped towards deep square leg for one.
Just a single to end the over then! South Africa continue to pile the pressure. On middle, this is hit to deep square leg for one.
Make it five! A length ball, outside off, late swing there. Malan looks to drive but misses.
Four dots in a row! Length ball, around off. Malan nudges it to mid-wicket.
On off, Malan again defends it out.
Outside off, Malan strokes it to covers.
Parnell starts with a length ball on middle. Malan watchfully defends.
Around off, Buttler hops and blocks.
THREE RUNS! A bit of width, outside off. Malan punches it to covers in the gap for three runs.
Full and on middle, this is pushed back to Jansen. Jansen forces Malan to get back as he has a go at the stumps.
On middle, blocked.
Jansen goes full and serves it outside off. Malan feels for it but fails to connect his blade.
Targets the off pole, Malan stays back to defend.
This is tidy bowling from Ngidi! Yet another excellent over! Giving nothing away. Length ball on off, Buttler blocks.
Length ball, outside off, left alone.
Pitched up on off. Buttler pushes it to mid off.
A slower bouncer on middle. Malan pulls it unconvincingly to short fine leg for a single. Falls safely there.
Keeps it around the off stump channel. Malan blocks it out.
On a length and outside off. Malan knocks it to point.
Around off, kept out.
On middle, blocked out.
Again this is outside off. Buttler lets it go.
Outside off, left alone.
On off, kept out.
Around off, flicked to long on for a single.
Well outside off, Buttler leaves.
Sharp inswinger! Length ball, outside off, comes back in a long way. Buttler looks to defend but misses.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Ngidi strikes again! He is loving life at the moment but England aren't. A length ball, outside off, again change of pace as this is at 133 clicks. Brook tries to cut but gets an outside edge to Heinrich Klaasen who makes no mistake. England in trouble.
Commentary.Howout: c Heinrich Klaasen b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and outside off. Brook leans and pushes it through covers for two.
That was a serious delivery! Scrambled seam! Length and on off. Brook manages to get an inside edge as this one tails in.
Short in length, outside off, cut straight to point.
Length ball, on top of off. Malan taps it to point.
Around off, defend solidly.
TWO RUNS! Length ball, outside off. Malan punches it past cover for a couple.
On a length and on middle. Malan keeps it out.
Outside off, left alone.
Wide! Tails down the leg side, Malan lets it go.
This is on middle. Malan defends it out.
FOUR! Brook hits the first boundary! Length ball, width outside off and Brook slashes it through covers for a four.
On off, blocked out.
Outside off, punched to cover.
Angles a length ball on the pads. Brook fails to get any bat on it. Was the off-cutter.
Serves it outside off. Brook lets it go.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Duckett goes now. Wow! What a bowling this is from Ngidi! He goes short and around off. Duckett tries to play the cut shot while the ball was very close to him. Gets an outside edge to the keeper who pouches it easily. Lungi Ngidi on a Hat-trick.
Commentary.Howout: c Heinrich Klaasen b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: Length and on off, kept out.
Leg bye! Sliding on the pads. Duckett misses his flick again. This time it rolls to square leg for a leg bye.
This is full and on the pads, tailing in. Duckett misses his flick. It was going over the stumps and Jansen knew it despite putting an appeal.
Goes full now on middle, it is pushed to mid on.
Wide!  Down the leg side, wided.
Short and outside off, keeps climbing. Duckett shoulders arms.
On the hips, Malan tucks it to square leg for a single. It is given as a leg bye.

OUT! TAKEN! Ngidi gets Roy again! A soft dismissal! This is on a length and outside off. Roy with a nothing shot really as he throws his bat forward and it goes off the higher part of the blade to mid off where Temba Bavuma takes a simple catch. A really good start by South Africa.
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Lungi Ngidi

Commentary.Commentary: Now this one swings away. Length and outside off. Roy flashes and misses.
Late in swing there. Length ball, outside off, nips in. Roy is drawn for a straight drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length and around off. Roy stays back and blocks.
This is way outside off. Roy leans to drive but mistimes it back to Ngidi.
Shorter and outside off. Roy shoulders arms to it.
Wide! Ngidi errs in line as he starts with a length ball, shaping outside off. Left alone.
Good start by Jansen! Just one to start the innings! Full and on off, played back to the bowler.
Length ball, way outside off. Malan shoulders arms to it.
Outside off, left alone.
Short in length and around off. Malan looks to defend on the back foot but is beaten on the outside edge.
On a length and around off. Malan taps it late to the fielder at second slip.
Jansen starts with a full ball, swinging on the pads. Roy tickles it to fine leg to get off the mark with a run.
It's time for action now. Jason Roy and Dawid Malan to open for England. Marco Jansen to start with the ball. Here we go...
We are all set for action. The players line up for the national anthems first. It will be England's first followed by South Africa.

Jos Buttler says they would have bowled as well. Adds they are disappointed to lose the series but are looking forward to this game. Reckons they want to do things properly and in their way. Shares they are building toward the World Cup. Informs Jofra Archer comes in for Olly Stone.

Temba Bavuma says they will bowl first. Adds it is a hard ground to defend and the comes nicely onto the bat later on. Informs Quinton de Kock and Keshav Maharaj miss out and Tabraiz Shamsi and Sisanda Magala come in.
